# Pre-registration: M1 via the spinor (Hermitian 2×2) form

*Written 10 Oct 2026, committed before any Lean code for M1 exists. Level: vyāvahārika. Do not edit after the result commit; corrections go in `reviews/M1-result-2026-10-10.md`.*

## Why this form
The author chose the spinor form (option 2 of the four M1 routes): it has the fewest assumptions, and Plücker/twistor coordinates should come out of it as a *derived* statement (target f) rather than an input.

## Setup (fixed in advance)
- Lean 4 v4.34.1, Mathlib pinned to the same revision as `<local path>`.
- Project: `lean/` in this repo. No `sorry`, no `native_decide`, no new `axiom`.
- Map σ : ℝ⁴ → M₂(ℂ), σ(t,x,y,z) = [[t+z, x−iy],[x+iy, t−z]].
- Quadratic form η(t,x,y,z) = t² − x² − y² − z².

## Target theorems
| ID | Statement | Required? |
|---|---|---|
| a | σ is ℝ-linear, injective, and its image is exactly the Hermitian matrices (packaged as a linear equivalence ℝ⁴ ≃ₗ[ℝ] {X : M₂(ℂ) // Xᴴ = X}) | required |
| b | det σ(v) = (η(v) : ℂ), i.e. det is real on the image and equals t²−x²−y²−z² | required |
| c | η has signature (1,3): the standard basis is η-orthogonal with values +1,−1,−1,−1 (and, if Mathlib's Sylvester machinery is reachable in reasonable time, a statement via `QuadraticForm`/`signature`) | required (basis form); Mathlib-signature form optional |
| d | For A ∈ SL(2,ℂ), X ↦ A X Aᴴ preserves Hermiticity and det, hence induces an η-preserving linear map of ℝ⁴ | required; kernel = {±1} optional |
| e | For Hermitian D: det D = 0 ⟺ D = ε · v vᴴ for some v ∈ ℂ² and ε ∈ {+1, −1} | required |
| f | For any X ∈ M₂(ℂ), the 2×4 matrix [I | X] has Plücker coordinates (p₁₂, p₁₃, p₁₄, p₂₃, p₂₄, p₃₄) given by 1, entries of X (up to sign), det X, and they satisfy p₁₂p₃₄ − p₁₃p₂₄ + p₁₄p₂₃ = 0 (affine chart of the Klein quadric) | stretch |

## Verdict rules
- **PASS:** a–e proved with `#print axioms` showing only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`.
- **PARTIAL:** at least a, b, c proved cleanly, with any of d–e missing, or proved only in a weaker stated form (recorded honestly).
- **FAIL:** any of the following:
  - the signature cannot be shown to be (1,3) in any stated formulation;
  - a required theorem needs `sorry`, `native_decide`, or a custom axiom;
  - the statement has to be weakened so far that it no longer says what this file says (e.g. det equal to η only up to an unstated sign or factor).
- f is a stretch goal: missing it does not change the verdict, but it is reported.

## What this does *not* claim, even on PASS
- That spacetime *emerges*: σ is a textbook isomorphism (CITED-level mathematics, e.g. Penrose & Rindler, *Spinors and Space-Time* vol. 1, §1.2 and §3.1), so a PASS means "formalised", not "discovered".
- Anything about positivity (M2) or about particles (M0′).
- That the real (Hermitian) slice is compatible with positive Gr⁺(2,4) data: that is the open reality-structure question.
